# dim_clients

`data-warehouse-359101.analytics.dim_clients` · dbt area: `marketplace`

Note -- this is superceded by dim_contacts, which should be used instead of this. Dimension table for Clients (aka Contacts) for whom advisors are booking travel for. Includes client contact information, preferences, and a history of first and last booked dates. Each row is a single Client / Contact. Sourced from the Portal database.

| Column | Description |
|---|---|
| `advisor_id` | Foreign Key. The 'User ID' in the Portal database  >>  SOURCE - Portal |
| `allergies_and_diet` | Any potential allergies or dietary restrictions listed by the client >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `archived_at` | When the record was archived ('archived' is similar to a deletion but without removing the record from the database)  >>  SOURCE - Portal |
| `client_id` | *Primary* Key. Unique identifier for the client in the Portal database  >>  SOURCE - Portal |
| `client_lead_id` | ID for the associated Client Lead in Portal (only if the client originated from the lead program)  >>  SOURCE - Portal |
| `created_at` | When the record was originally created  >>  SOURCE - Portal |
| `first_booked_date` | Earliest 'Booked Date' of all Bookings associated with the Client. Includes Canceled Bookings.  >>  SOURCE - Portal |
| `first_name` | Client's first name  >>  SOURCE - Portal |
| `full_name` | Client's full (First & Last) name  >>  SOURCE - Portal |
| `has_birthday` | Whether client profile has an important date labeled birthday added >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `has_card` | Whether client profile has a credit card on file >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `has_email` | Whether client profile has an email on file >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `has_email_with_advisor_contact_form_submission` | True/false flag of whether the client has any email associated with an Advisor Contact form submission.  >> SOURCE - Google Analytics |
| `has_email_with_client_lead_form_submission` | True/false flag of whether the client has any email associated with a Client Lead Program form submission.  >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `has_important_date` | Whether client profile has any important date added >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `has_phone_number` | Whether client profile has a phone number added >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `has_same_email_as_another_client` | Whether client has the same email as another client >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `is_archived` | Whether they have an 'Archived At' timestamp present  >>  SOURCE - Portal |
| `is_complete_client` | Whether client has a first and last name, email or phone added, and card added to profile >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `is_enriched_client` | Whether client has a first and last name, email or phone added, card added, and any important date added to profile >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `is_from_advisor_contact` | True/false flag of whether the client was matched to the advisor, using any email, through an Advisor Contact form submission. >> SOURCE - Google Analytics |
| `is_from_client_leads` | True/false flag of whether the client is from a Client Lead Program assignment in Portal. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `is_from_website_form_submission_match` | True/false flag of whether the client is from either a Client Lead Program assignment or an Advisor Contact match. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `ktn` | A client's 'Known Travel Number', which is the ID associated with TSA Pre-Check. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `last_booked_date` | Most recent 'Booked Date' of all Bookings associated with the Client. Includes Canceled Bookings.  >>  SOURCE - Portal |
| `last_name` | Client's last name  >>  SOURCE - Portal |
| `last_web_form_submitted_at` | The time of a client's last form submission on foratravel.com before being matched with their advisor, where applicable. >> SOURCE - Google Analytics |
| `middle_name` | Client's middle name  >>  SOURCE - Portal |
| `passport_sex` | Client's sex as listed on their passport >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `preferred_name` | Client's preferred name  >>  SOURCE - Portal |
| `prefix` | Client's name's prefix  >>  SOURCE - Portal |
| `pronouns` | Client's preferred pronouns  >>  SOURCE - Portal |
| `suffix` | Client's name  >>  SOURCE - Portal |
| `type` | The type of client (client or traveler). 'Clients' are individuals who made the Booking while 'Traveler' is an individual accompanying them. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `updated_at` | When the record was last updated  >>  SOURCE - Portal |
| `web_conversion_channel_grouping` | The last click channel grouping for a client's converting session on foratravel.com, where applicable. >> SOURCE - Google Analytics |
| `web_conversion_device_category` | The device category for a client's converting session on foratravel.com, where applicable. >> SOURCE - Google Analytics |
| `web_conversion_page_path` | The page path of a client's form submission on foratravel.com, where applicable. >> SOURCE - Google Analytics |
